basic_profile.bio: I'm a seasoned mechanic with a passion for cars and technology. Based in California, I love spending my weekends working on my collection of vintage vehicles. I enjoy sharing my knowledge and helping others solve their automotive issues. When I'm not under the hood, you can find me watching NHL games or playing video games. I'm a night owl, often browsing Reddit during late hours. Currently single, I work as a full-time auto technician at a leading service center.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of automotive mechanics, thanks to over a decade of experience working in various service centers. I also hold certifications from the National Institute for Automotive Service Excellence (ASE). My knowledge is continually updated through online courses and automotive forums.
